note: Space Range pack: one shared IC epoch before Cosmos plane-change gaps, then time-compressed illustrative Δi burns preserving the May GP-derived step sequence and magnitudes. Exercise timing is not historical. TEME, not J2000. Not Spaceflux-fitted. ICEYE-X36 and Cosmos 2611 are catalog-only. Integrity ISR ~105 m/s is a third-party check, not a measurement.
compression_policy: First burns are staggered by target offsets; each later burn for that spacecraft uses its immediately following equatorial node. The source catalog-timing manoeuvres remain embedded separately.

manoeuvres.assumption: Time-compressed exercise impulse at the first equatorial node after its assigned target. Catalog Δi, ΔV, order, and source window are preserved; historical waits are not. RAAN and mean-motion changes are not fitted.
manoeuvres.direction_definition: RTN local orbital frame: R is radial outward, +N is r×v (orbit angular momentum), and T = N×R is transverse/prograde. N is normal to the orbital plane. This burn has zero R/T component. For the observed positive Δi, burn +N at an ascending node or -N at a descending node.
